question: A certain number of class I students are sitting in a row on their graduation day, facing north. Ruchi is ninth to the right of Pranavi. No student is to the left of Pranavi. Tanya is fifth to the right of Ruchi. Vipanchi is seventh to the right of Tanya. If no other student is sitting in the row, what is the total number of students seated?
solution:
From the given information:

Step 1: Ruchi is ninth to the right of Pranavi. No student is to the left of Pranavi.
